name: POST /api/leadflow/calendar/synthetic-test - exercise the booking link before a prospect does
description:
The weekly synthetic booking test (2fc627e9-9a59-4d21-ad5e-b7301b6d1990#AC3). THE ONLY WAY TO KNOW A LINK WORKS IS TO USE IT: reading configuration proves the settings exist, it does not prove the provider will accept a booking, which is the failure a prospect otherwise discovers on the company behalf.

AN UNREACHABLE SERVICE IS A FAILURE, NOT AN UNKNOWN. An untested link is exactly the state this catches, so the verdict is false rather than null - reporting "we could not check" weekly would let a broken link sit indefinitely behind a soft status.

NO BOOKABLE SLOTS IS ALSO A FAILURE. A link offering nothing is indistinguishable to a prospect from one that is broken, so an empty availability response fails rather than passing with a zero. VERIFIED LIVE: the probe reached sdk-scheduling and returned exactly that verdict, correctly, because no rep calendar is connected in this environment.

THE PROBE ASKS ABOUT TOMORROW rather than today. A test run late in the afternoon would find no remaining slots on a perfectly working link and report it broken.

A FAILURE ALERTS rather than only being recorded, because a weekly test nobody reads is a weekly test that catches nothing. QA: depends on register and login.

testCases.name: The test exercises the link and reports a pass or a fail with its reason
NEGATIVE: no Authorization header at all
NEGATIVE: a bearer token that does not verify

errorCases.when: no rep is named and the caller has no session user to fall back on.

errorCases.message: Authorization header with a bearer token is required
errorCases.when: the Authorization header is absent, empty, or uses a scheme other than Bearer.

errorCases.message: Session token is invalid or expired
errorCases.when: a Bearer token was presented but does not verify.
